import random
from boltons.dictutils import OrderedMultiDict, FastIterOrderedMultiDict
for seed in range(100):
    random.seed(seed)
    a, b = OrderedMultiDict(), FastIterOrderedMultiDict()
    for i in range(1000):
        k=random.randrange(20); v=random.randrange(10)
        op=random.choice(['add','set','pop','popall','poplast','clear','update','update_extend'])
        args=[(random.randrange(20),random.randrange(10)) for _ in range(5)]
        results=[]
        for obj in (a,b):
            try:
                if op=='add': result=obj.add(k,v)
                elif op=='set': result=obj.__setitem__(k,v)
                elif op=='clear': result=obj.clear()
                elif op.startswith('update'): result=getattr(obj,op)(args)
                else: result=getattr(obj,op)(k)
            except KeyError: result='KeyError'
            results.append(result)
        assert results[0]==results[1], (seed,i,op,'return')
        for multi in (False,True):
            assert a.keys(multi)==b.keys(multi), (seed,i,op,'keys',multi)
            assert a.items(multi)==b.items(multi), (seed,i,op,'items',multi)
        assert list(reversed(a))==list(reversed(b)), (seed,i,op,'reversed')
print('FastIterOrderedMultiDict matches OrderedMultiDict across 100000 mutations')
